subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose a stable structured `session_status` usage contract, and if so which usage sources and freshness/privacy semantics are guaranteed to agents?
rationale: The request adds a durable agent-tool API and combines transcript totals, optional provider quota windows, cost semantics, and access boundaries; code inspection alone cannot choose the permanent public contract.

options.title: Sponsor an additive tool contract
options.body: Add documented `usage.session`, `usage.lastTurn`, and explicitly optional provider-window fields with source, freshness, and unavailable states while preserving existing rendered status output.

options.title: Keep usage on gateway surfaces
options.body: Retain structured usage in gateway/UI APIs and leave `session_status` as a display-oriented tool, documenting that agents should not parse status text as an API.

options.title: Narrow the first slice
options.body: Expose only transcript-derived token totals first, deferring cost and provider-window fields until their provider contracts and visibility semantics are settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor an additive tool contract
recommendation.body: Add documented `usage.session`, `usage.lastTurn`, and explicitly optional provider-window fields with source, freshness, and unavailable states while preserving existing rendered status output.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available routing candidate from the supplied current-main consolidation history and prior review of the same tool boundary.
